items: Open the draft site preview (ONE Websites builder, Preview)
Open the agent's My Profile in ONE Brain
Open their old website, if they have one
Count the Check badges still showing in the builder (the number at the top)

steps.say: Thanks for the time. We'll walk through your new site together. Nothing goes live until you press Publish yourself, so say anything you want changed.
items: Agreed how long the call will take (30 to 45 minutes)
Told them they press Publish, not us
Name, spelled the way they want it shown
Brokerage legal name exactly as on the Utah Division of Real Estate record
Team name, if any (it shows beside the brokerage, never instead of it)
Licence number, mobile, email
The areas they serve, in order of importance
Who they mostly help (first-time buyers, luxury, sellers, land...)
steps.rule: Utah rule: the brokerage name shows on every page. If what they say differs from the profile, fix it in My Profile so it changes everywhere.

items: Their first reaction to the look (keep, change, or try another template)
Logo file: have one, need one, or text name only
Colours they love or never want
Headshot to use (and any photos of them working)
Listing or area photos they own and want used
One or two sites they like, for ideas only (we never copy them)

steps.say: Pulse wrote a first draft from your profile. Let's read the parts marked Check so the words sound like you.
items: Read the home page headline and intro aloud; changes noted
Bio checked: true, current, in their voice
Numbers (homes sold, years, ratings): only real ones they can stand behind, or leave them out
Area guides: anything they would add about the place and the homes
Every Check badge looked at
steps.rule: Fair housing: describe places and homes, never who lives there. No "safe", "family-friendly", "exclusive" or school-quality claims. Census figures stay as published.

items: Leads from the site go into ONE MOVE: confirmed they know where to find them
Pulse chat on the site: Off, Ask me or Autopilot (default Off; their choice)
Home value requests: Pulse drafts it, they check it and send it
Texts go from their own phone; nothing is sent to a client unless they chose it
Old site address, and pages worth keeping
Domain: keep their own, or use name.vip50homes.com (VIP-50 buys a custom domain if they want one)
Who holds the old domain login (they keep it; we never ask for passwords on the call)
Google Business Profile: do they have one, and is it theirs
Real, named clients only, with each person's permission
Where their reviews live now (Google, RateMyAgent, Zillow)

steps.say: I'll send the changes through today. You'll get the updated draft, and when it's right, you press Publish.
items: Listed every change back to them
Agreed when they'll see the next draft
Asked whether they want the SOI setup next (if they don't have it)
Open their ONE MOVE contacts and the import summary
Note how many contacts, duplicates found and missing phones or emails

steps.say: We've brought your contacts into ONE MOVE and tidied them. Let's check it together. Nothing is sent to anyone from this setup.
items: Told them nothing goes out to contacts without their choice
Phone contacts, Google Contacts, old CRM export (Lofty or other), spreadsheets
Anything missing (a second phone, an old email account)
Duplicates merged: spot-check five with them
Picked their VIP list (target 50, up to 75)
Each VIP has a phone and an email where known
Birthdays and home anniversaries filled where known
"Tell Us About You" details filled where they know them
steps.rule: Open house visitors and tour buyers go to ONE MOVE tagged by source, never straight into the VIP-50.

items: Past clients, sphere, vendors, agents tagged
Anyone who asked not to be contacted marked do-not-contact
Anyone who must not get texts or emails noted
Which plans to start, and for whom
Each plan's automatic texts and emails: off unless they switch them on
SOI managed monthly ($149): want Pulse to draft every monthly touch for them to approve?

steps.say: You're set. Your first touches will show up as tasks in ONE GO for you to send.
items: Listed what was set up
Showed where tomorrow's touches appear in ONE GO
